exposure: Cholecystectomy during the third trimester of pregnancy
Cholecystectomy in the early postpartum period (within 3 months)
cohort: The study participants were women who underwent cholecystectomy either during the third trimester of pregnancy or in the first 3 months postpartum, identified from the California Office of Statewide Health Planning and Development database.
finding: Maternal delivery and procedure-related outcomes, including preterm delivery, were significantly worse when cholecystectomy was performed during the third trimester of pregnancy compared to the early postpartum period.
